title: Audit Admin API contracts in sequential 20-route waves

spec.problem: Complete the source-discovered active API audit in deterministic 20-route waves. Each METHOD+PATH is individually exercised against its actual handler, caller/auth boundary, response contract, and persistence or side effect; repair locally solvable defects and preserve external blockers explicitly.

acceptance.text: Individually execute and record every METHOD+PATH in spec.api_scope: status/body/auth/input contract plus persistence or side effect using safe disposable fixtures; explicit external blockers are recorded and independent routes continue.

All mutations use disposable local fixtures, enforce router permissions and CSRF, produce required audit records, and avoid changing canonical content; targeted RED/GREEN tests plus Go race/vet/architecture and frontend checks pass.

Exercise practical Admin UI callers in the visible authenticated browser at 390x844 and verify corresponding same-origin Network responses and resulting UI state; record UI-less endpoints as API-only.
Audit each scoped API METHOD+PATH one by one; no module-wide inference or sibling-route PASS substitution.
Wave 8: all four learner gamification routes match the active frontend response contracts, enforce learner session and CSRF on mutations, and persist each daily reward at most once.
Login bonus status and claim are based on Tokyo calendar days, expose the seven-day reward schedule expected by the widget, and claim atomically with persisted reward details.

Mystery box status reports goal completion and today reward in the frontend contract; open requires completed daily study goal, awards one active weighted reward once per Tokyo day, and status reflects persisted reward.

spec.expected_behavior: Route-level PostgreSQL tests prove auth/CSRF denial, client contract, goal gating, one-claim-per-day, and persistence.
spec.observed_behavior: Existing handlers allow duplicate same-day login claims, ignore claim persistence errors, return response keys the widgets do not consume, and permit mystery-box opens without checking the daily study goal.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only AUDIT-159-owned handler changes/tests and inventory evidence. All database fixtures are disposable and must be removed. Do not mutate authored content.

classification.rationale: AUDIT-159 API waves include route contracts, auth, PostgreSQL, Search, visible UI, and audit checkpoints.
